rig.key_off_stations: fill_scale 0: no front light at all, only a source behind the actor -- near-silhouette with a rim

corneal_pass.model: dielectric corneal CAP truncated at the limbus (sin theta = 5.85/7.8), Principled black base, roughness 0.02, IOR 1.376; the round 34 construction
corneal_pass.anchor: limbus centre smoothed by a local quadratic (+/-2 frames) from relight/limbus_track_tv_import.json, proxy depth; sphere centre 5.16 mm behind the iris centre along the geometry gaze
corneal_pass.visible_to_camera: the corneal caps only; bulb and fill hidden, proxy absent

note: Clay-skin proxy only: no plate texture, so every value on screen is computed geometry and light rather than photography.
